Evacuation Guide

Follow official instructions from MDRRMO Looc and Barangay officials. Do not wait until conditions become dangerous.

WHERE TO EVACUATE
  • Go to the designated evacuation center assigned by your Barangay.
  • Choose a safe area away from flood zones, landslide-prone areas, and storm-surge zones.
  • Follow the official route and instructions of responders.
WHEN TO EVACUATE
  • When a pre-emptive or mandatory evacuation order is issued.
  • When flooding, storm surge, landslide, fire, or other hazards threaten your area.
  • Evacuate early, especially children, senior citizens, pregnant women, and persons needing assistance.
AFTER EVACUATION
  • Return home only after authorities officially declare it safe.
  • Check for damaged structures, electrical hazards, gas leaks, and floodwater risks.
  • Report missing persons, injuries, and damage to Barangay officials or MDRRMO.

Before You Leave

Bring your Go Bag, important documents, medicines, drinking water, food, flashlight, and communication devices.

Ambient Weather Connection

Connect your Ambient Weather station in about 1 minute. Paste the two keys below; the dashboard will automatically find your station.

OPEN AMBIENT ACCOUNT
CONNECT
1. Open Ambient Weather Account
2. Create/copy the 2 API keys
3. Paste both keys and connect

No MAC address is required. The dashboard automatically detects your first available station.

For this standalone HTML dashboard, the keys are stored in this browser. Do not publish the file with your private keys embedded in the source. Ambient Weather requires both an Application Key and an API Key.
